column1: # qos Desktop in Tamil: XFCE's own text.
# English<TAB>Tamil. The English is as XFCE shows it, without the "_" that marks
# the keyboard shortcut and without a trailing "..."; build.py restores both,
# writing the shortcut as "(_X)" after the Tamil. %s, %d and the like must be
# the same on both sides, or build.py leaves the line out.
